settings.backup.none_yet: No backups yet — the first daily snapshot happens a couple of minutes after the till starts.
settings.backup.nothing_to_restart: Nothing is staged to restart right now.

settings.backup.staged: Restore staged. The current data will be kept as a pre-restore backup.

settings.catalog_pre_pack_unit_price.hin: Off by default. Uses the net quantity set on each item. Items sold by weight always show their price per kg, whatever this setting says. Smaller shops may be exempt from unit-pricing pre-packed goods, so this is your call — see Help.
settings.catalog_pre_pack_unit_price.lab: Show unit price (per kg / per litre / per item) on pre-packed item labels
settings.currency.help: How prices are written on this till: symbol or word, its position, and whether the currency has decimal subunits (pound has 100 pence; rial and toman have none).
settings.currency.title: Currency
settings.currency.warning: Changing the currency does not convert existing prices — amounts stay as entered, only the label and decimals change.
settings.data.archives_help: Each time the transaction history is cleared, the records are moved into a dated archive batch here instead of being destroyed. A batch can be restored — whole and exactly as it was — for as long as the till has not traded since that reset.
settings.data.archives_purge_retained_un: This archive holds real trading history and is protected by your country's retention rules until %s — it cannot be deleted before then.
settings.data.archives_restore_conflict: This till has traded since the reset — the archived batch can no longer be restored automatically.
settings.data.archives_restore_reference: This archive references a product, stock location or customer that was removed or erased after the reset (e.g. by "Remove sample data", catalog cleanup, or a customer erasure) and can no longer be restored automatically.
settings.data.archives_retained_until_ro: Retained until %s — protected by your country's retention rules
settings.data.catalog_help: Permanently remove inactive products that were never sold and have no stock history. Anything ever sold is kept for your records. Tick the option below to also clear a wrongly imported catalog before go-live.
settings.data.catalog_in_basket_cashier: A product this cleanup would remove is in the current basket — clear the basket first.
settings.data.catalog_in_basket_kiosk: A product this cleanup would remove is in the self-order kiosk's basket — clear the kiosk basket first.
settings.data.catalog_include_active: Also include active products that were never sold
settings.data.catalog_include_active_hel: Use this to clear a wrongly imported catalog before the shop goes live. Products that were ever sold or stocked are still kept.
settings.data.catalog_preview_none: Nothing to remove — no never-sold products match (tick the option above to include active ones).
settings.data.catalog_removed_none: Nothing was removed — no products matched. Products with sales or stock history are always kept; active products are only included when that option is ticked.
settings.data.customer_search_ph: search by name, phone or email
settings.data.demo_confirm: Remove all sample data? Items with real trading history are always kept.
settings.data.demo_in_basket_cashier: Sample data is in the current basket — clear the basket first.
settings.data.demo_in_basket_kiosk: Sample data is in the self-order kiosk's basket — clear the kiosk basket first.
settings.data.demo_item_has_history: This item has trading history and can't be removed this way — deactivate it from Catalog, then run Catalog cleanup from Settings → Data (manager only).
settings.data.demo_item_remove_anyway_co: Remove this item permanently? This can't be undone.
settings.data.demo_kept_customers_intro: The following sample customers could not be removed automatically:
settings.data.demo_kept_list_intro: The following sample items could not be removed automatically:
settings.data.demo_kept_promos_intro: The following sample promo codes could not be removed automatically:

This customer has sales on record, so they're kept to protect your records
A promotion is set up for this customer
settings.data.demo_kept_reason_held: This item is in a currently parked sale
settings.data.demo_kept_reason_history: This item has real trading history, so it can't be removed — deactivate it from Catalog, then run Catalog cleanup from Settings → Data (manager only). Items with trading history are always kept, to protect your records.
settings.data.demo_kept_reason_promo_tar: This promo code is set up for a specific customer
settings.data.demo_present: This till has %d sample record(s) (catalogue items, customers, and promo codes). You can remove them here.
settings.data.demo_promo_kept: Kept as your own promo code.
settings.data.demo_promo_not_found: That promo code was already gone.
settings.data.demo_promo_remove_anyway_c: Remove this promo code permanently? This can't be undone.
settings.data.demo_promo_targeted: This promo code is set up for a specific customer and can't be removed this way.
settings.data.export.help: Trigger an installed export or report plugin (e.g. a fiscal DSFinV-K export) for a date range of up to 366 days. Files download straight to this device; other exports just confirm they were sent.
settings.data.export.none_installed: No export or report plugin is installed.
settings.data.export.title: Export / report
settings.data.gdpr_help: Delete a customer's personal details on request. Their sales are kept for your records but no longer show who they belonged to.
settings.data.gdpr_invoices_kept: Invoices already issued keep the buyer's name, address and VAT number exactly as issued, because tax law requires you to keep them.
settings.data.help: Clear the practice sales made while testing so you can start real trading from a clean slate. Your products, users and settings are kept.
settings.data.reset_done: Archived %d sale(s) into batch %s — restorable from Settings → Data until the till trades again.
settings.data.title: Data management
settings.data.warn: This clears ALL sales, shifts and invoices (not only test ones) from the working till in one go — it is meant as a one-time reset before going live. Nothing is destroyed: the records move into a reset archive below and can be restored until the till trades again. The action itself is recorded in the audit log.
settings.diagnostics.ended_remotely: The last session was ended by Universal Till support (%s).
settings.diagnostics.err_code_required: Enter the activation code you received from support.
settings.diagnostics.err_code_unavailabl: That code was already used or has expired — ask support for a new one.
settings.diagnostics.err_invalid_code: That code is not valid for this shop. Check it with support and try again.
settings.diagnostics.err_not_registered: This till is not registered with Universal Till Cloud yet — register it first (see the Registration section).
settings.diagnostics.err_refused: Universal Till Cloud refused this request. Check the code and try again, or contact support if this keeps happening.
settings.diagnostics.err_unauthorized: Universal Till Cloud did not accept this till's credentials. Re-register the till and try again.
settings.diagnostics.err_unreachable: Universal Till Cloud could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
settings.diagnostics.intro: Universal Till support may ask you to turn on diagnostic mode for this till. While it is on, the till sends structured technical events (plugin answers, tax-rate sources, table and order status changes, app and plugin versions — never receipts, prices, names or notes) to Universal Till until you turn it off here or support ends it. It needs a one-time activation code from support.
settings.diagnostics.log_intro: The till keeps its technical log in this folder: till.log is the newest, till.log.1 to till.log.4 are older ones (at most 25 MB in total, so it never fills the disk). Passwords and tokens are removed before anything is written. If support asks for the log, copy the path, open it in your file manager and send them the files.
settings.diagnostics.log_off: This till is not writing a log file (the Android and iOS apps never do; elsewhere it is turned off with UT_LOG_FILE=0, or the log folder could not be created).
settings.diagnostics.on_explain: This till is sending structured technical events to Universal Till support. It stays on until you turn it off here or support ends the session. A small indicator stays in the menu bar the whole time.
settings.diagnostics.stop_confirm: %d unsent batches (%d events) on this till will be discarded, not uploaded. Turn diagnostic mode off?
settings.diagnostics.stop_confirm_none: Nothing is waiting to upload. Turn diagnostic mode off?
settings.diagnostics.stopped: Diagnostic mode is off. %d unsent batches (%d events) were discarded.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostic mode
settings.display.additional_kiosk_use_pr: This till is an additional till. To make it a self-order kiosk, use Settings → Device profile — it asks first and tells the main till.
settings.display.basket_panel_help: On the sell screen, press and hold the divider between the basket and the product buttons (or just click and drag it with a mouse) to make either side bigger. Reset puts it back to the default split.
settings.display.effects_help: Lighter effects keep a Raspberry Pi or an older computer smooth. Auto picks Light on a Raspberry Pi, on Linux, or on a weak machine, and Full everywhere else. This till's own setting, never copied to other tills. If the system's “reduce motion” setting is on, animations stay off at every level.
settings.display.err_invalid_mode: Choose a device profile: Register, Back office or Self-order kiosk.
settings.display.exit_to_os_help: Requires a manager PIN. Leaves full-screen or kiosk mode right away and hands this till's window back to the OS desktop.
settings.display.exit_to_os_kiosk_applia: This till is a dedicated kiosk appliance with no OS desktop to exit to — nothing changed. Use the window mode setting above to turn the kiosk screen off instead.
settings.display.exit_to_os_not_confirme: The till's window was asked to close, but hasn't confirmed yet — check the till's screen. The exit was recorded.
settings.display.exit_to_os_unavailable: This till's window can't be reached, so it can't be closed from here. Nothing changed.
settings.display.help: Scale the whole interface for this till's screen. Small touch panels: 70–80%. Large displays: 130%+.
settings.display.launch_on_startup_pendi: Takes effect once this platform's autostart support ships.
settings.display.satellite_mode_blocked: This till is a satellite — it can't be set to Register or Back office. Change its role on the main till's Tills page first.
settings.display.title: Display
settings.display.window_mode_kiosk_appli: This till is a dedicated kiosk appliance: the kiosk screen is driven by the till itself, with no OS desktop behind it. To leave kiosk mode, switch the window mode here — "Exit to OS window" does not apply on this till.
settings.display.window_mode_no_shell: Full-screen and kiosk modes stay off until the Universal Till desktop app is running on this till — that app is what owns the window, and what lets you leave full screen again.
settings.display.window_mode_pending_not: On the Pi kiosk and on Linux and Windows desktops, this applies immediately. On macOS, your choice is saved but the window stays normal until that platform's support ships.
settings.display.window_mode_shell_attac: The Universal Till desktop app is running and holding this till's window — window-mode changes apply immediately, and "Exit to OS window" really hands the screen back. Full screen and kiosk run the till on top of this computer's own desktop, which stays right behind it — a fresh install on a Raspberry Pi with a desktop starts this way automatically.
settings.enrol.auto_register.help: When on, the till sends its device ID, store name, shop country, shop region and software version to the Universal Till cloud marketplace for support, updates and licensing — and registers right away when you save. Your address is not sent. When off, it registers only when you first use the plugin store or press Register now. Turning this off does not undo a registration that already happened.
settings.enrol.auto_register.label: Register this till with the marketplace automatically
settings.enrol.benefits: Registering is free and connects your till to the plugin store: install plugins with one tap and unlock cloud features as they arrive. It happens automatically when the till is online — or register now with the button below.
settings.enrol.busy: Another registration attempt is still running — wait a moment and try again.
settings.enrol.check_plan_sent: Checking with the cloud. If this shop is on a paid plan, cloud sync starts within a minute.
settings.enrol.claim_expires: The code is valid for 15 minutes.
settings.enrol.claim_failed: Could not get a claim code — check the internet connection and try again.
settings.enrol.claim_help: Link this store to your Universal Till ID to manage it online (My stores, fleet, paid features). Generate a code, then sign in on the marketplace and enter it.
settings.enrol.claim_open: Open the claim page and enter the code
settings.enrol.claim_scan: Or scan with your phone to claim there
settings.enrol.cloud_sync_off: Cloud sync is off. It is part of the paid plans — once this shop is on one, the till syncs with your online account automatically.
settings.enrol.failed: Registration failed — check the internet connection and try again.
settings.enrol.forbidden: Only a manager or admin can register this till.
settings.enrol.name_required: Name your shop first: the till registers with the cloud only once the shop has a real name.
settings.enrol.not_configured: No cloud address is set up on this till, so it can't register. The till keeps working offline; ask whoever installed it to set one up.
settings.enrol.not_registered: This till is not registered yet.
settings.enrol.pair_failed: Pairing failed — check the code and the internet connection, then try again
settings.enrol.pair_help: Got a pairing code from your shop's cloud account (“Add or re-pair a till”)? Enter it here to add this till to that shop, or to reconnect a till that was removed or needs pairing again. This replaces only this till's cloud connection; its sales, products and settings stay.
settings.enrol.pair_replica_no_store: This till has not received its shop from the main till yet, so the code was not used. Wait for the main till to sync (or check it is reachable), then try again.
settings.enrol.pair_store_mismatch: This code belongs to a different shop than this till's main till. Ask for a pairing code for this shop and try again.
settings.enrol.pair_success: This till is now paired with the shop.
settings.enrol.registered: This till is registered with the Universal Till marketplace.
settings.enrol.registered_via_main: This till is registered through the main till.
settings.enrol.service_unavailable: The Universal Till cloud is not available for this shop. The till keeps working offline.
settings.enrol.title: Till registration
settings.error.change_on_main_till: Change this setting on the main till.
settings.error.main_till_refused: The main till refused this change.
settings.error.main_till_unreachable: Can't reach the main till — change this setting on the main till, or try again when it's back.
settings.error.save_failed: Could not save — please try again.
settings.fiscal_signer.missing.message: This shop is set up to trade as the legal system of record, but no fiscal-signing plugin is installed — sales are not being signed. Install the country's tax plugin to fix this.
settings.fiscal_signer.missing.title: No fiscal signer installed
settings.home.label: Settings categories
settings.idle_lock.help: Lock the till when it sits unused. The operator signs back in with their PIN — the basket is kept exactly as it was.
settings.idle_lock.title: Auto-lock
settings.invoice.help: Fill in your business details to turn on VAT invoices: an Issue-invoice button appears on every receipt in the journal, numbering is sequential, and refunds of invoiced sales get a credit note automatically. Leave the name empty to turn the feature off.
settings.invoice.title: Invoices
settings.kiosk_idle_reset.help: On a self-order kiosk till, reload back to the start screen after this many seconds of no touches — clears the screen for the next customer.
settings.kiosk_idle_reset.title: Kiosk idle reset
settings.language.downloads_on_select: A language under “More languages” downloads in the background when you apply it. The till keeps working and switches language once it has arrived.
settings.language.help: The till's default language — used for notification email and anything else with no browser to ask, not just this screen's own language. Your own browser's language stays whatever you last picked, whether or not it matches this setting.
settings.language.install_unavailable: %s couldn't be downloaded: it isn't in the plugin catalog right now, or it was removed under Settings → Data. The language hasn't changed.
settings.language.installing: Downloading %s… The till keeps working and switches language when it arrives.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.order_no.help: The short number shown to customers and printed on kitchen tickets — separate from the receipt number, which stays permanent for refunds and reports.
settings.order_no.title: Order numbers
settings.order_type_prompt.help: Choose when the sale screen asks the cashier for dine-in or takeaway.
settings.order_type_prompt.label: Ask
settings.order_type_prompt.mode_off: Off — this shop doesn't sell food or drink to eat in
settings.order_type_prompt.mode_top: At the top of the basket (default)
settings.order_type_prompt.title: Dine-in/takeaway prompt
settings.payments.default_help: The preferred method appears first at checkout — put your cheapest or house provider here.
settings.payments.fees_help: Provider fees (what each provider charges you): percent + fixed per transaction. Checkout shows an estimated fee next to each button so the cashier can pick the cheaper one.
settings.payments.title: Payments
settings.printer.discover.error: Could not search this network for printers.
settings.printer.discover.help: Scans for network printers advertising themselves over AppSocket/JetDirect (raw socket, port 9100) — an IPP-only printer, or one connected by USB, will not appear here and must be entered above by hand.
settings.printer.discover.none_found: No AppSocket/JetDirect printers answered on this network. If yours is IPP-only or connected by USB, enter its address or device path above.
settings.printer.help: Print receipts silently on a thermal printer. Network mode talks to any WiFi/Ethernet ESC/POS printer; device mode writes to a plugged-in USB printer (e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 on Linux/Pi).
settings.printer.kitchen_group.title: Kitchen printer
settings.printer.kitchen_help: A separate printer for kitchen tickets — network host:port (e.g. 192.168.1.60:9100) or a device path. Leave empty to turn kitchen printing off.
settings.printer.receipt_policy.advisory: German law (§146a Abs. 2 AO) requires offering every customer a receipt — “Ask the customer” satisfies this. “Never print automatically” is only appropriate if the shop already offers a digital receipt or holds a §148 AO exemption; the shop is responsible for its choice.
settings.printer.receipt_policy.title: Receipt after each sale
settings.printer.system_hint: For a regular office printer (e.g. HP), pick “Regular printer” — receipts are sent as plain text to the system default printer. Put a specific printer name in Address to target it, or leave blank for the default. Thermal printers use Network or USB device (ESC/POS).
settings.printer.test_ok: Test receipt sent — check the printer
settings.printer.title: Receipt printer
settings.retention.capacity_advisory: Report archives are small — a few KB per closed day — and won't fill a modern till's disk over the 10-year window.
settings.retention.err_invalid_mode: Choose where to keep reports: this till only, cloud only, or till + cloud.
settings.retention.err_needs_subscriptio: Keeping reports in the cloud needs an active subscription that includes cloud backup. Reports stay on this till.
settings.retention.err_use_retention_car: Change where reports are kept on the Report retention card.
settings.retention.help: Choose where your end-of-day report archive is kept and for how long. Reports are always kept for at least 10 years.
settings.retention.pending_uploads: Reports waiting to upload to the cloud: %d
settings.retention.title: Report retention
settings.retention.upload_refused: Cloud upload refused — the subscription is not active. Reports stay on this till and upload once it is active again.
settings.search.label: Search settings
settings.search.none: Nothing matched. Try a shorter word, or pick a section from the list.
settings.sell_screen.browsing_mode_all_f: Shows every item at once, with a row of category buttons above the grid to narrow it down.
settings.sell_screen.browsing_mode_categ: Shows a tile for each category; tap one to open a popup with every item in it and a search box.
settings.sell_screen.browsing_mode_strip: Shows your quick buttons under a row of category tabs, with a … button at the end when there are more categories than fit.
settings.sell_screen.title: Sell screen
settings.service_charge.invalid_rate: Enter the service charge as a percentage of zero or more, for example 12.5.
settings.service_charge.tr_forbidden: Turkish law bans a service charge, table fee or cover on the bill (Fiyat Etiketi Yönetmeliği, in force since 30 Jan 2026). Price it into your menu items instead.
settings.shop_type.help: The kind of business this till serves — chosen at setup, changeable here.
settings.shop_type.service_layout_note: Choosing Service trade also enables the Salon menu layout: it hides Tables and Kitchen stations and relabels Items to Services. Find hidden tiles again under Settings → Hidden menu tiles. Switching away removes the layout completely.
settings.shop_type.title: Shop type
settings.staff_languages.error_default: The shop’s default language can’t be removed from the list.
settings.staff_languages.error_unknown: That language isn’t installed on this till.
settings.staff_languages.help: The languages staff can switch to from the ☰ Menu. The shop’s default language is always included. With just one language selected, the Menu shows no language buttons.
settings.staff_languages.title: Languages shown to staff
settings.stock_tracking.hint: Turn this on if you do not count stock. Items sell even when the till has no stock record for them, and nothing is ever refused for being out of stock. Leave it off if you want the till to stop a sale when an item runs out.
settings.stock_tracking.label: Sell items without tracking stock
settings.stock_tracking.title: Stock
settings.store_name.error_invalid_chars: The shop name can’t contain line breaks, tabs or hidden characters.
settings.store_name.error_required: Enter your shop’s name. It is printed on every receipt.
settings.store_name.error_too_long: The shop name can be at most 80 characters.
settings.store_name.help: Printed on every receipt and shown on reports.
settings.store_name.title: Shop name
settings.tax_rate_switcher.missing.messa: This country requires dine-in/takeaway VAT rates to be applied correctly, but no working tax-rate plugin is currently active — dine-in/takeaway rates are not being applied correctly. Install the country's tax plugin to fix this.
settings.tax_rate_switcher.missing.title: No tax-rate plugin installed
settings.telemetry.enable: Send plugin telemetry to the marketplace
settings.telemetry.help: Share anonymous plugin install/update/error status with the marketplace to help spot problems early. Off by default — nothing is sent unless you turn this on.
settings.telemetry.title: Plugin telemetry
settings.theme.help_per_till: Applies to this till only. Each till, including a self-order screen, can have its own theme.
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.tills.help: Connect more tills to this shop so they share catalog, sales and stock.
settings.tills.open: Manage tills / pair a new one
settings.tills.register_help: Cash payouts (e.g. a deposit refund) are recorded against this register's open shift. If your shop has more than one register, set this before recording payouts.
settings.title: System Settings
settings.tse.awaiting_ready: TSE setup is in progress — your signing service is being prepared. This till picks up the result automatically.
settings.tse.credential_failed: The signing credential could not be fetched yet — this till keeps retrying automatically.
settings.tse.dismiss_blocked: This notice can't be dismissed while TSE setup is unresolved — recording real (system-of-record) sales in this shop needs a working TSE. Fix the cause, then use Retry.
settings.tse.kickoff_rejected: TSE setup could not be started: %s
settings.tse.nothing_to_retry: There is no failed TSE setup to retry.
settings.tse.pending_kickoff: TSE setup is waiting to reach Universal Till Cloud — it keeps retrying in the background.
settings.tse.reason.invalid_request: the submitted business details were not accepted — check the tax number
settings.tse.reason.not_configured: TSE provisioning is not available on this marketplace yet
settings.tse.reason.subscription_inactiv: an active subscription is required for a managed TSE
settings.tse.see_settings: You can retry TSE setup from Settings.
settings.tse.title: Receipt signing (TSE)
settings.update.android.downloading: Downloading — Android will ask you to confirm when it is ready
settings.update.android.failed: Could not start the update — check the connection and try again
settings.update.android.install_again: Didn’t see Android’s installer? Tap to open it again
settings.update.android.no_bridge: This update can only be installed from the till app itself
settings.update.android.pin_needed: Enter the manager PIN to install this update
settings.update.apply_confirm: Download and install the update now? The till restarts when done.
settings.update.auto_blocked: Automatic updates are on, but this till can't install them by itself: its install folder isn't writable by the till. If it was installed from the .deb package, reinstall the latest one — that fixes the folder; otherwise give the till's user write access to that folder. Then check again.
settings.update.check_failed: Could not reach the update server — try again later
settings.update.follows_main: This till follows the main till's version (%s). Change automatic updates on the main till.
settings.update.follows_main_checks_off: Update checks are switched off on this till, so it won't follow the main till's version. Whoever set this till up can switch them back on.
settings.update.follows_main_failed: This till couldn't update itself to the main till's version (%s). To try again, press Update now for this till on the main till's Tills page while the two are connected.
settings.update.follows_main_manual: This till can't install updates by itself, so it won't follow the main till's version (%s). Install that version on this till by hand.
settings.update.follows_main_off: Automatic updates are off on the main till, so this till won't update by itself. Switch them on at the main till so this till follows it again.
settings.update.follows_main_unknown: This till follows the main till's version. Change automatic updates on the main till.
settings.update.title: Software update
settings.update.unavailable_here: In-app update isn't available for this install
